public.title: Drizzle Query Builder III
public.description: input {left,right,leftKey,rightKey,kind}; kind is inner or left. Join rows when left[leftKey] strictly equals right[rightKey]. Emit {left:row,right:row} in left source order and then right source order for multiple matches. For left joins emit right:null for unmatched left rows. Both tables contain at most 12 rows with primitive-valued fields; no filtering/projection in this join adapter. Return joined rows. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Nested-loop joins preserve both source orders and track whether a left row found any match. O(L times R plus output) time and output-sized space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
